name: 5 V, 1 A, TO-220 linear regulator
summary: Turns 7–35 V into a steady 5 V at up to 1 A.

faq.a: Turns 7–35 V into a steady 5 V at up to 1 A.
A loose TO-220 in an antistatic bag. No heatsink.
Pin 3. Pin 1 is the input. Pin 2 is ground.
The Texas Instruments LM340 and LM7805 family datasheet is linked on this page.
